task.question: Which sector_name has the highest average closing price across all of its instruments and all dates? Return the sector_name.

result.question: Which sector_name has the highest average closing price across all of its instruments and all dates? Return the sector_name.
result.cited_sql: SELECT s.sector_name, AVG(p.close) as avg_close FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id JOIN sectors s ON i.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY s.sector_name ORDER BY avg_close DESC LIMIT 1
